name: Browse portfolio and embedded work
description: Verifies the portfolio presents the resume sections and loads the public work rail.
steps: Scroll to the X posts section
expected: The portfolio shows the resume-based profile, experience, selected work, and an X posts section without requiring sign-in.

name: Save an X post as admin
description: Verifies an authorized admin can save a valid X status URL and see it appear in the public work rail.
steps: Sign in with the portfolio owner's email
Paste a valid X status URL and save it
Return to the portfolio and refresh
expected: The saved post remains in the public post rail after refresh and renders as an official X embed.

name: Reject invalid post URL on mobile
description: Verifies the admin form works on mobile and refuses non-X URLs.
steps: Open the admin route on mobile
Sign in with the portfolio owner's email
Paste a non-X URL and attempt to save
expected: A clear validation message appears and no invalid URL is added to the public post rail.
